item.title: The team behind Tailwind CSS is joining Shopify

item.title: Here's a report on what it achieved
item.description: In July 2022, Ruby Central and Shopify launched Ruby Shield, a four-year partnership built around a single goal: giving the tools at the heart of the Ruby ecosystem the sustained investment they need to stay secure and reliable. (1 source: rubyweekly)
